title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey fined DataOne $1.07 million for violating the state Air Pollution Control Act at a data center site in Vineland. State inspectors visited in late July and found 62 natural gas generators, each 2,000 kilowatts and about tractor trailer size. None had permits to be installed or operated. Officials said it was the largest fine ever given to a data center operator in New Jersey.

The Vineland campus is planned as a 2.6 million square foot complex needing 350 megawatts, enough to power a medium size city, and is scheduled for completion at the end of the year. Some of it is already in use. It has drawn complaints, including a federal lawsuit by homeowners over persistent noise and violation orders from the Cumberland County Health Department for excessive noise. Governor Mikie Sherrill said data center builders must benefit New Jersey communities.
